model: Sure Shot Z115 Panorama (Caption)/Prima Super 115N (Caption)/Autoboy S XL
tagline: 佳能便携相机，1999 年发布
description: 佳能于1999年推出的便携相机。配备38-105mm zoom, f/3.6-8.5. (10 elements in 9 groups, including an aspherical element for excellent sharpness.)。Three-point AI active auto-focus from 0.6m to infinity. (0.4m close range in macro mode).。

specs.Camera-wiki: Canon Sure Shot Z115 Panorama (Caption)/Prima Super 115N (Caption)/Autoboy S XL
specs.镜头: 38-105mm zoom, f/3.6-8.5. (10 elements in 9 groups, including an aspherical element for excellent sharpness.)
specs.对焦: Three-point AI active auto-focus from 0.6m to infinity. (0.4m close range in macro mode).
specs.取景器: Direct zoom viewfinder. 0.47x-1.22x magnification and 84% coverage, with focal length markings, LED ready and low-light warning.
specs.英文简介: A March 1999 model from Canon's phenomenally successful Sure Shot range, this compact 35mm film camera - known variously as the 'Sure Shot Z115 Panorama', 'Prima Super 115N' and 'Autoboy S XL' was a top of the range compact zoom.
